question: In which sports, Amit Panghal won a gold medal in Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boxing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amit Panghal** is a renowned Indian boxer who has represented India in various international competitions.
 
• He won the **gold medal in the men's flyweight category (51kg)** at the Commonwealth Games 2022 held in Birmingham, UK.
 
• His victory in the Commonwealth Games added to his already impressive career, which includes medals at the Asian Games and World Championships.
 
• Amit Panghal is known for his tactical prowess, quick footwork, and strong defensive abilities in the boxing ring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Boxing**

 
 
• Boxing is a combat sport in which two people wearing protective gloves throw punches at each other for a predetermined amount of time in a boxing ring.
 
• The sport is overseen by a referee over a series of one- to three-minute intervals called rounds.
 
• Boxing matches are won either by points or by stopping the opponent through knockout or technical knockout.
 
• Boxing is divided into different weight classes, ensuring fair competition among boxers of similar sizes.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930 and takes place every four years.
 
• The Commonwealth Games include a variety of sports, with the number of participating nations and athletes growing over the years.
 
• It is considered one of the major international sports events, alongside the Olympics and the Asian Games.
 
 
 
• **Amit Panghal's Achievements**
 
 
• Amit Panghal has won multiple medals in his boxing career, including a silver medal at the 2018 Asian Games and a bronze medal at the World Boxing Championships.
 
• He is known for his skill and agility in the ring, making him one of India's top boxing talents.
 
• His performance at the Commonwealth Games 2022 further solidified his status as an elite boxer.
 
• Amit Panghal continues to train and compete at the highest level, representing India on the international stage.
